title: コンピュータシステムとＡＩ
subtitle: Computer Systems and AI
teachers:
MATSUSHITA Yutaka
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Information technology (IT) and artificial intelligence (AI) are essential elements of modern society, and they are realized by computer systems. In this course, students will learn the structure and operating principles of a central processing unit (CPU), memory, and the input/output units that are the main components of a computer. In addition, students will learn the fundamentals of AI.
advice:
This course covers the following basics of computer systems:

1. Computer components
2. Principles of calculation, instruction execution control
3. Assembler language
4. Configuration of storage devices and memory
5. Calculation methods for performance evaluation
6. Fundamentals of AI
requiredKnowledge:
This is the first course covering the internal structure of computers.
Students should review numerical expressions such as binary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the components of a computer
Be able to understand programs written in the assembler language.
Be able to explain calculation control.
Be able to understand the configuration of memory.
Be able to understand basic properties of an operating system.
Be able to understand the fundamentals of AI

achievementLevels.ideal:
Be able to fully understand a basic computer system, its system components, software, and hardware.

Be able to completely resolve problems related to computer systems within the scope of the Japan Information-Technology Engineers Examination (Information-Technology Promotion Agency, Japan).

Be able to understand the fundamentals of AI.
achievementLevels.standard:
Be able to understand the fundamental concepts of a basic computer system, its system components, software, and hardware.

Be able to understand the overview of AI.

              Information technology (IT) and artificial intelligence (AI) are essential elements of modern society, and they are realized by computer systems. In this course, students will learn the structure and operating principles of a central processing unit (CPU), memory, and the input/output units that are the main components of a computer. In addition, students will learn the fundamentals of AI.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course covers the following basics of computer systems:

1. Computer components
2. Principles of calculation, instruction execution control
3. Assembler language
4. Configuration of storage devices and memory
5. Calculation methods for performance evaluation
6. Fundamentals of AI

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This is the first course covering the internal structure of computers.
Students should review numerical expressions such as binary.
